# Safety Moment: Synthetic pump fire, 2024

*About 1 min read*

**Audience:** Session leaders: supervisors and trainers giving a ten-minute safety moment

**Incident:** Synthetic pump fire · 2024-03-20

## Bottom line

- A joint you opened is not proven until its leak test is recorded. [FND-0001; EVD-0001] *(learning: LR-01)*

## What happened

A pump was restarted after a seal change without a leak test, and the seal leaked [FND-0001; EVD-0001]. The work order had no line for the test [FND-0002]. *(learning: LR-01)*

## Did you know?

The gas alarm on that pump only showed on a panel; it did not stop anything [FND-0004].

## What you can do

- [ ] Ask for the signed leak-test record before any restart. [FND-0001] *(learning: LR-01)*
- [ ] Check the new seal against the specification on the work order. [FND-0003]

## Questions for the crew

**Q: Which job on our unit ends without a test we can show?**
- Why it matters: The restart went ahead with no recorded test [FND-0001].
- Answer: Any job that opens a pressure joint should end with a recorded leak test.

**Q: What does our gas alarm do when it sounds?**
- Why it matters: The alarm only displayed [FND-0004].
